heroHeadline: Former South Korean Minister Sentenced to 25 Years for Role in Martial Law Declaration
heroSubtitle: A former South Korean minister was sentenced to 25 years in prison for his role in the December 2024 martial law declaration, marking a major legal reckoning for the political crisis.
